title: Marrying Dolores Ferdinand and buying the house
summary: He names his wife and tells how he bought the house from his father.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: But you have this music – you have this degree. You’re back in New Orleans. You’re trying to get gigs. You’ve just recently married. I presume you would like to state the name of your wife?
Dolores Ferdinand. She had gone to Grambling and finished – graduated in home economics, which was considered one of the best home-ec departments in the whole state.
Did you know her before you had gone into the Marines?
